title: Exact Decision and a Surjective Stabilizer Atlas for Affine Coprime-Factor Segments
summary: We consider simultaneous internal stabilization of square proper real-rational plants of arbitrary but fixed finite input-output dimension $n$, arranged as an affine right-coprime factor segment, under explicit nondegeneracy hypotheses. After a classical normalization, the remaining global spectral-cut constraint and the reconstruction constraints at finite poles and at infinity are encoded, without loss, as a finite-dimensional semialgebraic seed, using a function-level double-Cayley factorization.
